destination.name: Wuyi Hot Springs
destination.tagline: A hill county of hot-spring resorts, old villages and mountain scenery
destination.description: Wuyi is a county in central Zhejiang whose economy rests on agriculture and tourism, and it is known for its hot-spring resorts. Mountains rise to the north and west, with Niutoushan the highest peak at about 1,560 m. Visitors also come for old villages such as Yuyuan, for temples, pagodas and valley scenery. Industry has been kept limited to protect its tourism.
whyVisit: Walk through old villages and valleys

goodToKnow.title: Soak in cooler months
goodToKnow.detail: Summers are hot, with July highs near 35°C. Hot springs are most pleasant from late autumn to early spring.

goodToKnow.title: Jinhua is the nearest city
goodToKnow.detail: Jinhua lies about 25 km north-west of Wuyi's centre.
